For example, the relationship that causes me the greatest happiness is my relationship with my SO. They really complete me and cause me indescribable joy. That said, we're fairly codependent and have caused each other a ton of anguish too.

My paramour and I don't mean that much to each other. Neither would alert the course of their life for the other and we'd drop each other instantly if it stopped being fun. Mutual respect and compassion is a good start.
Communication. With that, everything can be fixed.

We dated for about a year and lived together for 8.5 years before we got married this past May. We also have a 5-year-old. We have had maybe 3 real fights in all of time we've known each other, and those were mainly because one person didn't just speak up and say what was on their mind first place.

Our "fights" are the lamest ever, too. It's mostly one person saying, "Yanno... you did XYZ and that bugged me." Other person: "I did that because of this thing that I didn't tell you about. I should have just told you. Sorry!" Fight over.

We're both allergic to drama, so this works for us!
